cadence: BDUK states that updated releases are planned alongside OMR closure notices, approximately once every four months.
quality_rules: A corrected release must supersede the earlier supplier-name version.
Schema stability does not imply row-value stability.
A UPRN missing from one release cannot be converted to no-service; it may be demolished, derelict or absent from the source epoch.
Current and future flags are source-date views, not live orderability checks.
Selected preview rows are QA examples and not representative estimates.
